card.name: Word-start letters before a split word
card.fires_on: A single letter or short piece (like E, T, .t, -t) that begins a rare word, drug or product name which the text then continues in the next piece. It appears in medical and technical text.

modes.label: Capital E or T opening a name
modes.description: A lone E or T that starts a drug or product name split into pieces.

modes.label: Lowercase t starting a term
modes.description: A t or -t that begins a longer medical or file term.
